BAML instrumentation / baseline record

Runtime baseline

2,420 batch-runtime observations, with separate compilation, memory, artifact and telemetry comparisons. Every chart is a static SVG: no controls, scripts or network requests.

Shared-host measurements. Background services remained active; affinity does not reserve cores. These results are a reproducible record of this machine and protocol, not an isolated-machine “pure baseline” or a universal language ranking.

Bars start at zero and show the median. Whiskers show the observed minimum–maximum, not a confidence interval. Values and sample counts sit below each chart; CSV downloads preserve the unrounded observations. Each plot has its own labelled linear scale; compare values, not bar lengths across plots.

Batch averages are not request percentiles. HTTP has separately recorded request latencies. Missing GC counters remain unavailable; zero means a counter was observed and no collections occurred.

Startup

What does one correct invocation cost?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Read a runtime-supplied integer and return its decimal representation.
Boundary
Fresh process, zero warmup, one job. Show whole-process wall/CPU/RSS alongside launch-to-ready and execution. Do not treat adapter startup as minimal hello-world.
BAML path
Engine creation, input conversion, call entry, result conversion and shutdown.
Evidence
Correct returned value; GC and telemetry counters attributed to their phase.
Claim
Fixed lifecycle overhead for this feature bundle. A run without GC is valid here and does not establish sustained performance.

Array traversal

What is the cost of traversing an integer array?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Sum an immutable array. Iterator and indexed variants read prepared input; build additionally copies by repeated append inside each job.
Boundary
Input parsing is outside execution. Sum and decimal result conversion are inside. Sweep lengths to separate entry overhead from per-element work.
BAML path
Iterable-for MIR lowering, ArrayIterator.next, array access and VM dispatch.
Evidence
Exact sum; inspect emitted code before attributing a change to iterator lowering. GC observation is reported but not required.
Claim
Traversal cost for immutable inputs. Mutable/aliased iteration semantics require separate correctness checks; this case is not a collector benchmark.

Merge sort

How well does user-written control flow execute?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Bottom-up integer merge sort with identical tie behavior. Each job copies the original input, allocates scratch, sorts and serializes the full sequence.
Boundary
Input parsing is outside execution. Copy, scratch, sort and serialization are inside. Test random/sorted/reverse/duplicate inputs and non-powers of two.
BAML path
Branches, nested loops, indexing, array mutation, allocation and dispatch.
Evidence
Entire output equals an independent reference sort; the input remains unchanged. GC coverage is observed, not assumed from temporary arrays.
Claim
Whole serialized sort-job cost. This is neither a native library sort comparison nor isolated instruction-dispatch timing.

JSON aggregation

What does a useful data-transformation job cost?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Parse records, validate ASCII account names, integer-valued cents in [0,1000000] and boolean active flags; group active amounts; sort and encode.
Boundary
Input text is prepared outside execution; parse/validate/group/sort/encode are inside every job. Invalid input returns {"error":"invalid"}.
BAML path
Native JSON parsing, typed heap values, maps, iteration, strings and encoding.
Evidence
Full result matches the independent oracle. Invalid fields and syntax are checked. No duplicate-key or invalid-Unicode equivalence is claimed.
Claim
Application CPU and wall time per correct serialized job. Native-library work remains in the result; faster JSON does not alone prove better MIR code.

Allocation & retention

What does allocation cost as the surviving object graph grows?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Allocate cells containing four integers, mutate through aliases, and keep a bounded ring of batches reachable. Verify total and retained sums.
Boundary
Allocate, mutate, traverse, replace retained batches and serialize sums inside each job. Retention spans batches within a job; it resets between jobs.
BAML path
TLAB reservations, allocation budget, safepoint parking, root scanning, copying survivors and repairing references.
Evidence
For a sustained-GC claim, observe repeated natural full collections inside execution and a bounded memory pattern. Shutdown-only GC does not qualify.
Claim
Allocation under the stated retention pattern. Sweep churn at fixed retention, then retention at fixed churn. Slots exclude backing payload bytes; RSS is not live heap. Rust preserves aliasing with Rc<RefCell<Cell>>. Higher retention also increases the final checksum traversal. A timing change therefore does not isolate the collector's copying cost.

Async fanout

What does concurrent suspension with retained state cost?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Spawn children, build one array per child, suspend for a timer, resume and sum each array. Join and verify all children in launch order.
Boundary
Child creation, allocation, wait, join and result serialization are inside each job. Positive timer delays measure concurrent waiting, not CPU scaling.
BAML path
Spawn/future dispatch, retained roots, suspension and resumption.
Evidence
Every child returns its expected sum. GC across suspension requires an observed overlapping collection; a timer alone does not establish it.
Claim
Orchestration cost at the declared fanout/payload/delay. This version does not assert that it exercises root relocation or cancellation.

  • crates/bex_heap/src/heap_guard.rs

Function calls

What does a source-level loop of small function calls cost?

Work, measurement boundary and compiler path
Work
Repeatedly call leaf(value) = value + 1 using a runtime-supplied seed/count. Return the exact final value. The same source algorithm runs in every language.
Boundary
Prepared input -> loop -> decimal result. Function inlining and loop elimination are allowed optimizations. Inspect generated code before claiming actual calls.
BAML path
Call lowering, argument/return handling, VM dispatch and function telemetry.
Evidence
Result equals seed + count. Medium/high BTEL records expose function completion totals. The reader checks run() totals; leaf-call attribution requires inspecting its recorded totals and emitted code. Low/off supply no such call evidence.
Claim
Cost of this source program under the selected optimizer and telemetry policy. No tracing-GC claim follows from this workload.
  • crates/bex_vm/src/vm.rs
  • crates/btel_settings/src/mode.rs
